# Free stack sources and licence records

The npm lockfile pins the installed motion libraries; their original licence files ship with the packages in `node_modules`. GSAP uses its Standard No Charge licence, Paper Shaders uses Apache-2.0, and Three.js / React Three Fiber / the Remotion integration packages use MIT. Remotion core retains its separate existing licence eligibility. See [the installation and source guide](../../docs/free-motion-stack.md).

`WYZOWL-SFX-KIT-CC0.txt` retains the CC0 licence text from Wyzowl SFX Kit at commit `92780e7ab0cdfb557497a988089c47f46e8c7412`. The committed `src/free-stack/sfx-catalogue.json` is derived from that revision's CC0 metadata; the raw WAVs are downloaded by `npm run setup:sfx` and checked against its SHA-256 values. No attribution is required by CC0; optional credit is “SFX Kit by Wyzowl”.

No premium asset licences, keys or paid sound packs are distributed by this integration.
